subject.title: agent-core: parallel batch runs a prepared paid tool after the run is aborted mid-batch

question: Which open candidate should maintainers land for the prepared parallel-tool abort race?
rationale: Two open PRs close this issue and touch the same agent-core boundary; one has stronger real behavior proof, so the issue should wait for a maintainer to choose and merge one path rather than queue another repair.

options.title: Land the proof-sufficient candidate
options.body: Proceed with review of https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102276 and close the duplicate candidate after one fix merges.

options.title: Use the duplicate candidate instead
options.body: Keep this issue open while https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102283 supplies comparable proof and maintainers intentionally choose that branch.

options.title: Pause both candidates
options.body: Hold both PRs if maintainers want a different cancellation architecture than a shared pre-execute guard.

recommendation.title: Land the proof-sufficient candidate
recommendation.body: Proceed with review of https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102276 and close the duplicate candidate after one fix merges.
